learning_outcomes.text: Explain RDS and Aurora engine and architecture options
Provision instances with appropriate storage and sizing
Design high availability with Multi-AZ and replicas
Plan backups, snapshots and point-in-time recovery
Secure and monitor a managed database

integrative_case: Run a production relational database on AWS: choose between RDS and Aurora, provision and size the instance with parameter groups, enable Multi-AZ and a read replica, set backup retention with point-in-time recovery, and secure it in a private subnet with monitoring.
